findings.evidence: Bare masculine participle 'retiré' has no visible noun to agree with. Its intended subject is the turn (le tour, m. — matches wire.outcome_notices.retired), but on a session row a reader supplies 'la session' (f.) or the status word. With a future localized base 'Interruption non vue' (f.) it would read as an agreement error ('Interruption … — retiré'). Today base is English, so no agreement is visible.
findings.fix: Gender-neutral cause phrase: '{base} — pour cause de mise à jour' (39/47 cells, shorter than current).
